sources.snippet: Complete Songs with Long-Range Coherence MiniMax Music 3 natively supports full-song generation up to five minutes. The model maintains musical themes, rhythm, vocal identity, and arrangement progression across long sequences, enabling complete structures such as intro, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, bridge, instrumental break, and outro.

sources.title: MiniMax Music 2.6 | AI Music Generator & AI Song Maker
sources.snippet: MiniMax Music 2.6 is the newest generation of MiniMax Music 's AI music model, released on April 10, 2026. Enter a style prompt and lyrics into this text-to-song AI, and it generates a complete, full-length song — including natural vocals, layered instrumentation, and genre-aware mixing — in seconds.
